artworks.title: Episode from the Algerian War
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The artwork depicts a chaotic battlefield filled with smoke, running figures, and artillery. In the foreground, some figures appear engaged in combat, showing vigorous movements. There are cannons. The tones used are grayscale. In the background, distant structures and more figures can be seen. The detail and dynamism capture the turmoil and action of the moment.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century, after Aegidius Sadeler II
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lesley Hill and Alan Stone
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up, positioned in profile with his attention focused on a book in front of him. His face has prominent features, including a deep-set brow and a long beard. He has short hair under a circular halo above his head. He wears loose robes and holds a feather pen, poised to write in an open book on a stand. Beside him, a lion's head is visible. In the background, there is a wall with a hat hanging on it, and in the foreground, a crucifix is prominently placed. The image is monochromatic with lines and shading.

artworks.title: Mars Sleeping
artworks.description: The image features a seated figure covered in a large cloak, revealing only their face and hands. They are seated on a spherical object, with a detailed helmet, sword, orbs, and gauntlet on the ground around them. The background shows a textured pattern, and the figure is situated in a corner with two intersecting walls.

artworks.title: Tomb of a Bishop
artworks.artist: Battista Angolo del Moro after Parmigianino
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lesley Hill and Alan Stone
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The upper portion shows a seated figure with a child, flanked by two winged angelic beings holding musical instruments. The figures are surrounded by floral motifs and display grandeur and reverence in their poses. Below is an arrangement with inscriptions framed by two cherub-like figures. The lower portion shows a gathering of figures dressed in ornate robes and hats, in a ceremonial or ecclesiastical setting. The style resembles Raphael, with intricate detail and a classical composition.

artworks.title: Procris
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a forest with distinct facial features, curly hair, and a leafy crown. The person is partially covered by draped fabric and is leaning on a tree stump. Large leaves surround them, and in the background, a figure wearing a crown is standing with a drawn bow. The background includes trees and foliage, with the word "PROCris" in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Petits Gâteaux (Little Cakes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Judith Brodie and Mervin Richard in memory of Virginia Jackson
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of four people from the waist up in a communal setting. The two figures at the center are prominently positioned, with the woman on the left wearing a hat with feathers and the man next to her wearing a top hat and an exaggerated expression. The center-right figure is a woman adorned in a fluffy, fur coat with her hands raised slightly, and her facial features are round with an expression of slight surprise. To the far right, a person is depicted in profile, wearing a knitted hat with a pom-pom, bending forward as if to observe something closely. The background shows a faintly sketched indoor setting with lighting fixtures or chandeliers.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.artist: Master of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.dimensions:
plate (shaped): 15.2 x 9.7 cm (6 x 3 13/16 in.)
sheet (cut around shaped plate): 15.5 x 10 cm (6 1/8 x 3 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded man standing with a large curved knife and an object in his hands. He is facing slightly to the left and has a halo drawn around his head. The man has curly hair and a full beard, and is dressed in flowing robes with a belt. He has bead-like decorations hanging from the belt. His feet are visible wearing closed shoes. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: etching with surface tone on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (cut within platemark at top): 43.4 x 31.1 cm (17 1/16 x 12 1/4 in.)
sheet: 43.6 x 31500 cm (17 3/16 x 12401 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with several figures: a woman sitting and leaning over an infant in swaddling clothes, two cherubs lying down, and a larger figure, possibly an angel, hovering in mid-air with one hand raised. The woman has delicate features and hair pulled back, wearing a draped garment. The cherubs have wings and appear to be observing. The larger figure has wavy hair and a serene expression, dressed in a robe. The background is softly textured with faint landscapes and foliage.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.medium: woodcut from 2 blocks on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in a natural setting. Three figures are in the foreground; one is kneeling with their upper body and hands visible. This person has long, wavy hair and a beard. The other two figures are seated on the ground with curly hair, shown from the waist up. In the background on the right, an angelic figure with wings is carrying a cup. The scene includes trees, foliage, a cloudy sky, buildings, hills, and a group of soldiers with spears and shields in the middle ground.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a forest scene. The artwork depicts a person with a hooded cloak kneeling beneath a canopy of leafy trees, reaching upward. The forest surrounds with trees and foliage detailed, with a path between them. In the distance, a castle can be faintly seen. The atmosphere is contemplative, with light suggesting a significant occurrence. Texture and form of the foliage and garments adds depth to the drawing.

artworks.title: Entellus and Dares
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to image): 30.4 x 26.9 cm (11 15/16 x 10 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: Two men are depicted in a full-body view, engaged in physical combat. They are both standing with legs apart, arms raised, and fists clenched. The man on the left is muscular, wearing a short, one-shouldered tunic. He has curly hair and a beard. The man on the right is also muscular, wearing a draped garment. He is clean-shaven with curly hair. Both men have bands around their fists and one wears a crown-like band on his head. The background shows an ancient stone wall with vegetation on top, and another stone structure to the right, resembling the façade of an ancient building, possibly an amphitheater. Grass and uneven terrain are visible beneath their feet.

artworks.title: Neureuther (Self-Portrait in the Etching Studio)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in an act of exploration in a detailed setting. The two central figures are located in an ornate, enclosed space, with one holding a large flask or container, and the other possibly observing or interacting with it. Surrounding the central scene are intricate motifs, including scrollwork, floral elements, and small mythical figures. Above the figures, a cloud-like form contains small ethereal faces. Flanking the scene are two small creatures perched on columns, each observing the central activity. Below the main tableau, reclining figures and children amidst oversized foliage add a whimsical element. The style is highly detailed, reminiscent of 19th-century illustrative work.

artworks.title: Bacchanal
artworks.artist: Jacob Wilhelm Mechau after Giulio Carpioni
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting mythological figures in a serene outdoor landscape. The figures are shown enjoying leisurely activities like reclining and playing musical instruments. The scene features trees, vases, and a statue hinting at classical influence. The environment exudes a sense of harmony and relaxation, evoking a pastoral or Arcadian atmosphere commonly found in mythological themes. The drawing's style reflects a classical tradition inspired by ancient Greek or Roman visual culture, emphasizing the timeless quality of pastoral idylls.

artworks.title: Cleopatra
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with knees bent and legs crossed, partially reclined, with a serene expression. The person's hair is held back by a headpiece, draped in fabric that reveals the chest and shoulders. They hold a serpent that coils around their arms. In the background, heavy drapery curtains are parted open, with fabric falling behind and around the figure. The background is dark, contrasting with the highlighted figure in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Sluice
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a wide landscape with a rustic building on the left. The horizon is low in the composition, featuring small distant structures like windmills. The scene is rendered in a detailed, precise etching style with a stark color palette. A barren tree extends towards the sky, with small birds in the skyscape.

artworks.title: Turkish Town
artworks.description: The image is a detailed woodcut illustration presenting a cityscape from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is near the top of the image, with rugged cliffs or rocky hills extending across the width. The illustration features fine line work with cross-hatching providing texture and shading to the buildings and natural elements. Closest to us are architectural structures of varying heights, including a building with a pointed roof and a minaret capped with a crescent. The skyline in the distance shows densely packed edifices, including towers and gabled roofs. On the left, a tall tree stands next to the built environment. The overall visual impact is a harmonious blend of urbanity with natural elements in stark black and white tones.

artworks.title: Turkish Town
artworks.description: The image depicts a narrow street with tall buildings on both sides. A rectangular building with a slanted roof is seen on the left, near a group of figures by an open doorway. In the middle distance to the right, a prominent minaret with a pointed top stands out. The horizon line is low, meeting a hilly landscape in the far distance filled with buildings. The artwork features precise linework typical of woodcut prints, with cross-hatching creating depth and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, using the paper's natural color and dark ink lines for a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: The Fall of Troy and the Escape of Aeneas
artworks.artist: Giorgio Ghisi after Giovanni Battista Scultori
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 37.9 x 49.2 cm (14 15/16 x 19 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with mythological and historical elements. The image displays figures engaged in various actions, featuring mythical beings and classical architectural structures. The left side depicts a scene with horses, chariots, and humanoid figures in conflict. The central portion shows more figures in motion. On the right, there's a cloud-like formation enclosing seated figures. The background includes a fortified city wall, with flames and smoke rising above. The lines and shading techniques suggest a control of pen and ink, creating a tapestry of narrative and movement.

artworks.title: View of the Sea, Normandy
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape from an aerial perspective. A cliffside is on the left, leading down to blue-green waters. The horizon is high in the image, marking where the sky meets the sea. The sky is predominantly blue with swirling clouds painted in soft brushstrokes. The technique adds texture and depth to the clouds and water. The color palette includes earthy tones on the cliffside transitioning to deeper blues and greens in the sea. The image conveys natural beauty and the vastness of the coastal scene.

artworks.title: The Herald of Murcia and Other Studies (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Athena Tacha and Richard Spear
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple sketches featuring a horse and rider. The drawing captures a variety of dynamic poses centered around a horse being ridden. The central figure depicts a horse in motion, with one foreleg lifted elegantly, while the rider holds a tall pole or lance. Surrounding this central image, there are smaller sketches visible; the top-left sketch suggests another rider in action, while to the right side, sketches include another horse being led by a figure holding a whip. The bottom-right features sketch lines and a partially rendered head. The pencil or ink lines demonstrate a fluid, gestural approach to capturing the energy and form of both horse and rider.

artworks.title: Woman with a Tambourine (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Athena Tacha and Richard Spear
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in traditional clothing standing in a pose with one hand on their hip and the other hand holding a round object. The person has short, wavy hair and is dressed in a long-sleeved blouse, a long skirt with an apron, and simple footwear. There is a plain background behind the person.

artworks.title: Dead Stag
artworks.description: The image shows a deer with large antlers lying on the ground, its head inclined downward. The color palette consists primarily of sepia tones, giving the image a vintage appearance. In the foreground, the deer is visible diagonally across the image from the bottom left to the right center, while the background features a grassy terrain stretching upwards.

artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated bearded figure with a halo, holding a quill, alongside a winged animal. The figure is draped in robes and is holding a quill pen in their right hand. Beside the figure is a large winged creature, resting at their feet. The setting includes architectural elements in the background. In the foreground, a cup or chalice stands alone. The illustration is detailed with strong lines and shading, reminiscent of classic woodcut designs.

artworks.title: Saint Luke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded figure. The figure is engaged in creative activity, possibly painting or drawing divine figures. The image depicts a bearded figure seated before an easel or similar structure, intently working on an artwork that showcases figures with halos. Surrounding the central figure are clouds and figures that resemble cherubs or angelic beings. The texture and style indicate the use of bold black lines on a muted background.
